answer: An identity earns its seat through signed proofreader accreditation with editorial society attestation, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 629 fakes pay 629 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill grows faster than its reward. One ridge of signal, one onyx of cost, one zenith of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
